candidate.name: Muhammad Rayyan Ahmed
credentials: M.Sc. Data Science (in progress), TU Ilmenau

letter.role_title: Working Student for Agentic AI & Engineering Automation (f/m/x)
letter.opening: I am applying for the Working Student position for Agentic AI & Engineering Automation. Building LLM prototypes that work with knowledge sources and evaluating them for reliability and traceability is exactly what my latest project is about.
letter.profile_intro: I am an M.Sc. Data Science student at TU Ilmenau with a B.S. in Artificial Intelligence. Before my Master's I worked with business data on SAP platforms as a Business Analyst and in SAP data consulting.

achievements.impact: I built a RAG system over technical PDF manuals with the Claude API that answered 91% of a 22-question test set correctly and refused all 4 unanswerable questions; hybrid BM25 and semantic retrieval raised MRR from 0.748 to 0.898
DocuMind cites the file and page for every answer, and its evaluation harness traced both wrong answers to chunk boundaries rather than the model
it runs as a FastAPI REST API with 37 offline unit tests, GitHub Actions CI and Docker

letter.problems_section: I would help identify engineering workflows that suit AI support, build prototypes that connect LLMs to tools, APIs and documents, and evaluate them for reliability and practical value. I have not built agents with tool calling yet; with my RAG and API experience I can learn agent frameworks quickly.
letter.closing: I am willing to relocate to Ulm and can work up to 20 hours per week, starting immediately. I would be glad to discuss the role.
letter.language_closing: I work in English (IELTS 8.0) and am currently learning German (A1).
